flows:
Navigate to https://radar.weather.gov/ then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Stay on this public site.
Do not sign in, register, pay, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge.
Leave fixture settings unchanged.
Use visible controls only.
Press Tab twice before making any accessibility assertion.
Continue using Tab or Shift+Tab through the controls to reach Play in the radar animation timeline.
Press Enter and verify the animation begins and the control changes to Pause.

summary:
The Play control was made non-focusable, even though it is a visible control that users need to operate.
Make the Play control keyboard-focusable and expose it as a real button (or an equivalent focusable button role). Verify that Tab reaches it and Enter starts the animation and changes its label to Pause.

verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent did not cause the failure. It followed the required keyboard-only path, including pressing Tab twice before the accessibility check and continuing to tab through controls. Because Play is excluded from keyboard focus, no permitted key sequence could reach it to press Enter.
